description:
Who is calling: returns the identity and subscription plan of the MCP token in use. No project id needed.

Returns { userId, name, email, organizationId, endpoint, plan }. endpoint is { path, mode (read-only or write), writeEndpoint } for the endpoint this call arrived on. plan holds the raw tier and expiry from the token plus the derived limits and permissions the other tools enforce: canWrite (writes allowed at all), sharingAllowed (whether invite_user will work — the app's Share-button rule), isEnterprise (large-project copies), maxProjects (null when no limit is enforced on MCP, with maxProjectsEnforced=false; planMaxProjects is the web-app plan value) and maxNodesPerProject (same: absent when not enforced, with maxNodesEnforced=false, maxNodesNote and planMaxNodesPerProject). limitsEnforced says whether those two caps are applied on MCP calls now, and limitsEnforcedFrom when they start (2026-12-31; the sandbox project is exempt); while limitsEnforced is false, maxProjects and maxNodesPerProject stay null as above. Call it at the start of a session to know your limits before creating or importing.
name: whoami
title: Whoami
